subject: Mosaic pilot: proposed mutual action plan + discount request
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@mosaichealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP and discount question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Mosaic is enthusiastic about testing Redwood for retrieval-augmented workflows across our care management product. Before we commit time from our infra and security teams, procurement has asked for a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, an evaluation plan, and confirmation of pilot pricing / any ramp discounts tied to milestones.

High level: we want a 3-month pilot with 10k queries/day target by month 3. If we hit the agreed performance (latency < 250ms p95, accuracy baseline from the eval set) we expect to commit to a Q3 paid rollout. Procurement wants to see margins/discounts for that pilot and any conditions for converting to a committed deal.

Can you send a draft MAP and proposed pricing for the pilot (including any temporary discounts) and outline the approval path on your side (VP / CFO / CEO approvals if needed)? Procurement is on copy (procurement@mosaichealth.com) and our infra lead Tom Rivers is available for a short sync.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Martinez
Head of Product, Mosaic Health
elena.martinez@mosaichealth.com

Hi Elena — great to hear. Attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (Mosaic-MAP-v3.pdf) and our standard term sheet (redwood-term-sheet-v2.docx) — both are marked as drafts so we can iterate.

Draft summary (high level):
- Pilot length: 3 months (trial window)
- Target: 10k queries/day by month 3; success gate: p95 latency < 250ms and evaluation accuracy on your test set within agreed tolerance.
- Pilot pricing: list price tokens + optional pilot discount (TBD) applied to usage during the pilot only.
- Conversion: if success gates met, we propose a transition to a committed plan with a minimum ramp commitment (example: $120k ARR first 12 months) with step-down discount schedule tied to committed volume.

Next steps: Can you confirm kickoff week preferences (w/c Apr 12 or Apr 19)? Also confirm whether Mosaic procurement needs a redline of the term sheet or just the MAP and pricing.

I will also loop in my internal approvals for any discount request — please expect an internal approval chain to be presented if you request >20% pilot discount.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi team,

Looping you in for a formal discount approval. Mosaic (external thread below) is asking for our proposed MAP + pilot pricing. They are targeting a 3-month pilot with a goal of 10k q/day by month 3 and an expected conversion to a committed rollout in Q3 assuming gates are met.

Ask: I am proposing we offer a 25–30% pilot discount off list for the 3-month evaluation period to reduce their paywall friction. If they convert to a committed plan (example ramp to $120k ARR in 12 months), we will step the discount down to preserve unit economics.

Why: Mosaic is a strategic healthcare prospect (HIPAA-adjacent workflows) with high expansion potential; they also require private deployment capabilities down the line. The MAP includes security checkpoints and an evaluation rubric.

Requested approvals:
- VP Sales (Ben) — ok to proceed with up to 30% pilot discount?
- Sales Ops (Laura) — confirm billing/crediting mechanics for pilot discount and trial usage accounting.
- CFO (Markus) — final sign-off required for pilot discounts >=25% (company policy).

Attachments: Mosaic-MAP-v3.pdf (draft), redwood-term-sheet-v2.docx (redlines still pending).

Timing: Procurement wants numbers by EOD Apr 5 to schedule procurement committee next week.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive — Mosaic Health (lead)
